{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

A folder of pictures with a caption next to each one (01_Cat.jpg + 01_Cat.txt, the way Caption All Images in a Folder for LoRA Training in folder 7 makes them). First read and fix the captions in one window, then make every picture again from its own caption, in a new style, in one Run.

 1. Fix the captions

  1. On Caption Review Pixaroma, click Browse folder and pick your folder (to try it, pick the demo folder Portraits in Media Inputs: it comes with a caption per picture).
  2. Click Review captions. Fix any caption, then Save changes. Close the window.
  3. Point Load Images from Folder and Load Texts from Folder at the SAME folder.

 2. Make the pictures again

  • Type a style in the second box of Text Join Two Pixaroma, or leave it empty.
  • Press Run once: every picture is made again from its caption, at its own shape.

 Captions are great prompts: they describe exactly what is in the picture. That is why the new pictures stay so close to the originals.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Portraits inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Flux 2 Klein 9B) - The image model, Flux 2 Klein 9B from Black Forest Labs. It is a fast 4-step model that can make a picture from words AND change a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3 8B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the image model understands.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2) - Turns the finished render into a picture you can see, and a picture into the model's own format.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Caption Review Pixaroma (1. read and fix the captions) - A window with every picture of the folder and its caption under it. Click Review captions, fix what the AI got wrong, and click Save changes. It never runs: it is a tool on the canvas.
  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (2. the same folder) - The same folder, so each picture's name and size go to the rest of the workflow. Its resize is Max megapixels 1, the size Klein works best at.
  • Text Join Two Pixaroma (3. a style for every picture) - Adds a style to the end of every caption, with a comma. Empty the second box to make the pictures from the captions as they are.
  • Seed Pixaroma (4. random or fixed) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same result every Run, R (random) a new one each Run.

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Load Texts from Folder Pixaroma (each picture's caption) - Reads the caption of EACH picture: its names input gets the folder's file names, so 01_Cat.jpg gets 01_Cat.txt, in the same order. A picture with no caption gets an empty text.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. Klein runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas the picture is painted on, at the size it receives.
  • KSampler (4 steps) - The render: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings Klein is made for.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (keeps each picture's name) - Saves each new picture as PNG into ComfyUI/output/From Captions, with the name of its original.
  • Image Grid Pixaroma (old and new, every picture) - Every original above its new picture, in one grid, with the names: the whole Run at a glance.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
4 pictures, 1 MP eachabout 10 s
Each picture you addabout 2 s more

Klein needs 4 steps, so it is fast: about 1.7 s for a 1024 x 1024 picture from a prompt and about 3 s for an edit at 1 megapixel, where it also reads your picture.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • Klein took about 3 to 6 times as long, about 10 s even for one picture: Klein and its text encoder (17 GB together) do not fit in 16 GB, so parts of them load again on every Run, and a second Run is no faster.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
